comparison.objective: Use a tong puller to remove a midget fuse from an open-clip block and place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Align and close a sprung puller around a small cylindrical fuse in tight clearance, extract it, release it, and put the tool down.
comparison.success_condition: Target fuse released and still in the tray with the puller set down; disturbing neighboring fuses fails and tool-free extraction caps credit.
comparison.reason: Precision tool seating is shared only generically; fuse grasp-and-extraction does not test adjustment preservation, jam-nut reaction, or post-lock actuation.
